notes: No primary project-table URL supplied; used the matching primary papers and their Table 1. Original source is an author proof with internal proof pagination. Both combined rows print only Stouffer combined p, with no combined F, Z, or named effect size; individual ANOVA statistics were not substituted. Original enrolled N=27 is not silently treated as a printed analytic n. Replication prose rounds p to 0.99; Table 1 precision 0.993 retained. Narrative reports no effort influence but gives no explicit replication-success verdict for this specific surprise-effort combined test; reported_success left null.
